errors.evidence: The description identifies the color of the 'where' bar as '紫红色' (purple-red/magenta). This is not the most accurate description, as the color is more of a medium purplish-pink (orchid). A more fitting term would be '粉紫色' (pink-purple), as used in the reference description, which better distinguishes it from the brighter pink 'why' bar next to it.
